definition_de: verschiedene Menschen oder Teile zu einer Einheit zusammenbringen (Die Musik eint die Menschen. Das Land wurde geeint.); gehobener als 'vereinen'
example_de: Beim Straßenfest einte die Musik der kleinen Band Junge und Alte aus dem ganzen Viertel.
example_en: At the street party, the little band's music united young and old from the whole neighbourhood.
visual_idea: Collocation 'die Musik eint die Menschen': young and old people who would normally not mix dance arm in arm in one big circle in front of a band, so 'bringing different people together into one' is visible. Rejected: 'das Land einen' (German reunification; needs history and reads as 'feiern') and 'die Fans einen' (a stadium reads as 'jubeln').
image_prompt: a street party on a cobblestone street between old apartment buildings on a summer evening, string lights above; a small band with guitar, accordion and drums plays on a low wooden stage; in front of it teenagers, young parents, and elderly people with grey hair dance together arm in arm in one big closed circle; a grandmother and a teenage boy in a hoodie hold hands and laugh
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: at a street party a small band plays while teenagers and elderly neighbours join hands one by one and form one big circle, then dance around together laughing under string lights; slow camera pull back
